title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to domestic violence/intimate partner violence training for employees and managers.
text:
[Council File 26-0885]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to domestic violence/intimate partner violence training for employees and managers.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. NOTE and FILE the Personnel Department report dated October 8, 2026.
2. INSTRUCT the Personnel Department to submit a $50,000 budget request to develop domestic violence/ intimate partner violence training for consideration as part of the 2027-28 budget development process.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Personnel Department. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted (Nov 6, 2026); Council action final
